svg.title: Matter, life and the limits of knowledge
svg.desc: An animated atlas of spacetime, quantum matter, chemical change, living systems, laboratory measurement and scientific inference.
svg.metadata: Scientific notes: Einstein field equation uses spacetime indices mu and nu and kappa=8*pi*G/c^4. The wavefunction illustration represents normalized single-particle probability density, not a many-body simulation. Reaction Gibbs energy uses absolute temperature and a dimensionless activity quotient. The open reaction-network equation assumes a well-mixed fixed-volume model with a defined stoichiometric matrix and external flux. The representation relation is a research acceptance contract requiring a declared question, domain, time horizon and error metric; it is not a proved universal identity. Proof judgements are relative to their premises. References: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/7-1-wave-functions ; https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/16-4-free-energy ; https://proceedings.mlr.press/v115/beckers20a.html .
